chapter: Union career, Masons, mentoring and the Clef Club
title: Founding the Clef Club
summary: Howard says he started the Clef Club as a monthly chartered social club with no playing, apart from the union.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: So you mentioned about the Clef Club, and you were one of the founders of it?
The Clef Club?
Yes. The Clef Club.
Oh, yeah, a long time ago.
What was the idea behind the Clef Club, what did they want to do, just have a social club or what?
Well, it was a social club to start out with.
I. mean just to have something once a month, just to have the members meet?
Ybah. Just something where the members can meet once a month, that's all.
Was there any musical activities involved with that?
No.
No playing, huh?
No, no playing, no.
Was this like a chartered club or not?
It was a chartered club, but it had nothing to do with the --
With the union itself.
No, the union, no.
Uh-huh. Do you remember --
Let's see, Arthur -- (Inaudible).
One of the main men we had to get out of it was Arthur Twine. We couldn't keep him in,
You mean he was in and you had to get him out?
Well, we couldn't keep him in there.
Because he just didn't fit in?
No, he just had the wrong attitude.
Yeah, I see. So he wanted it to be something else.
Yeah.
Do you remember any other names at that time when it began?
Arthur?
No, do you remember any other names at the time the club began, the Clef Club?
Oh, no, I don't remember no other names.
No-one helped you form it?
Nobody helped me or nothing.
The club is still active now, isn't it?
Yeah, the club is still active.
Do they still have their meetings the same way, or is it now a musical affair?
It's a musical affair. They don't have too much of anything.
What do they do now? Can you explain what they do? Do they have parties or dances or jam sessions or what?
No, nothing.
When you say musical affairs do the musicians take part in the playing or something?
They did.
Do they do that now too?
No.
Well, did they have one just recently that you remember?
(Inaudible) Not that I remember.
A little closer, please.
Not that I remember they never had any. And you know another thing, Buddy?
Yes.
You just don't see them people no more.
The people that belong in the Clef Club?
